title: Matryoshker use-case registry (contract v2)
description: Schema for data/<repo>/usecases.json: a JSON array of use-cases. See docs/data-contract.md, sections 4 and 5. v1 Portuguese keys and status values are accepted as aliases. Extra keys (notes, preconditions, documented, ...) are allowed and ignored by the pipeline.

citation.description: Must contain a file citation path/file.ext[:Symbol]. Hops: "path/file.ext:Symbol — role". Entry points: "[kind: ][label ]path/file.ext[:Symbol][ — text]" with kind in http|command|event|cli|cron|other (no prefix = other).

status.description: Canonical: human-verified | agent-verified | inferred | hypothesis | outdated. The v1 values verificado-humano, verificado-agente, inferido, hipotese (hipótese), desatualizado map to them. human-verified is only ever set by a human.

frame.description: One frame of the call stack behind the hops (data-contract.md 4.4). Frames are a derived reading of the code, produced outside this tool and re-produced when a cited file changes.

id.description: Unique within the use-case; how other frames name this one.

parent.description: The id of the frame that called this one; null (or absent) opens a stack.

edge.description: How execution reached this frame from its parent. worker and inbound reopen the stack at depth 0; other requires edge_note. An unknown value is coerced to other with a warning.

edge_note.description: What the boundary is. Expected when edge is "other"; its absence is a warning, not an error.

hop.description: Citation of this frame, same grammar as a hop (data-contract.md 5.1). An inherited method cites the class that declares it, with the method name in role. No line numbers: a line reference is kept but warned about.

role.description: What the frame does; truncated at 140 characters.

registry.description: Free text tying the frame back to the flat registry ("hop 3", "frame only", ...). Printed verbatim, never parsed.

status.description: Epistemic status of this frame. Defaults to the use-case's and is capped by it: a frame never outranks the use-case it belongs to.

status_reason.description: Why the frame has that status. The prefix "mock:" means it was executed with mocked data; it adds no status value.

name.description: Unique within the file. The viewer keys local status drafts by it.

goal.description: One sentence: what the actor achieves.

entry_points.description: Entry-point citations (data-contract.md 5.2). Unresolved ones stay as documentation and produce no node.

hops.description: Hop citations in execution order (data-contract.md 5.1). A hop whose file does not resolve is dropped and reported on stderr.

frames.description: Optional call stack behind the hops (data-contract.md 4.4 and 7.4). Every hop must be cited by a frame; not every frame is a hop. Omit the key entirely and nothing about the build changes.

rules.description: Business rules the use-case touches (shown in the viewer).

seam_crossing.description: True when the flow crosses an architectural seam (shown as a badge).

async_legs.description: Documentation only; ignored by the pipeline.

failure_paths.description: Documentation only; ignored by the pipeline.

tests.description: Documentation only; ignored by the pipeline.
